name: Stability conditions on free abelian quotients
abstract: In my first project, I studied the stability manifold of (smooth projective) surfaces which are free abelian quotients. One approach is via group actions on triangulated categories, another is via Le Potier functions.

name: Cyclic covers: Hodge theory and categorical Torelli theorems
abstract: We studied derived categories of cyclic covers, and the question of whether such a cover can be recovered (up to isomorphism) from its Kuznetsov component.

name: Fusion-equivariant stability conditions and Morita duality
abstract: We investigated how stability conditions behave under actions of fusion categories (=tensor categories with extra structure). A crucial example is that, if a finite group \(G\) acts on a category \(\mathcal{D}\), then the corresponding \(G\)-equivariant category \(\mathcal{D}^G\) is a module category over \(\mathrm{rep}(G)\) (which is a fusion category). As an application, we generalise results from my first project to non abelian groups.

name: Thesis: Stability conditions and group actions
abstract: This thesis covers my first project on free abelian quotients, and the generalisations to non abelian groups in my project joint with Edmund Heng and Anthony Licata.

name: Coherent sheaves in logarithmic geometry
abstract: A ubiquitous strategy in algebraic geometry is to study a complicated geometric object by degenerating it to a union of simpler objects. This leads to the basic question: How can we recover geometric information about a variety, its coherent sheaves, and its derived category from their degenerations? Logarithmic geometry is a suite of tools for studying certain degenerations. In this project, we developed a theory of logarithmic coherent sheaves. In a follow-up paper, we will also study the associated logarithmic derived category.
